defect_name: Shotgun - claims not separated into counts
what_the_test_showed: Sixteen discrete counts, each with its own legal basis heading and its own 'Against:' line.

defect_name: Shotgun - group pleading / count against a defendant with no basis
what_the_test_showed: Count IX is asserted against MEB, Shellpoint AND SLS. Shellpoint and SLS are pleaded as servicers, not as parties to the HELOC contract. A failure-of-consideration count cannot run against a non-party to the contract.
cure: Limit Count IX to MEB Loan Trust VIII.
cost_if_not_cured: A clean partial dismissal that costs credibility on the count's stronger half against MEB.
notes: Count IX is strategically the most important count because it avoids the Ames standing bar. Do not weaken it with an obviously bad defendant.

what_the_test_showed: Paragraph numbering is continuous 1-through-N across Sections A-J. Every 'PP X-Y' reference resolves to exactly one set of paragraphs.
notes: THE DEFECT PRESENT IN SRC-001 IS GONE. SRC-001 restarted numbering in each Roman-numeral section so 'Paragraphs 1 through 46' was ambiguous. This pleading fixed it.

what_the_test_showed: Five defendants captioned; each is the target of at least one Count. LENDAGE, LLC IS NOT IN THIS CAPTION.
notes: MATERIAL IMPROVEMENT OVER SRC-001, which captioned Lendage while asserting no count against it - directly contrary to Doc. 34 at 21 and 22 n.11. Dropping Lendage removes the Rule 10(a) problem and the add-a-party question entirely.

what_the_test_showed: Facts specific to SLS exist and are good (PP 24, 30, 42 - the $10,000 reversal, the $855 suspense movement, the reinstatement reporting), but P 31 attributes SLS-era conduct to Shellpoint.
cure: Reattribute P 31 to SLS. The ledger marks both $855 rows 'PriorServicer' and they predate Shellpoint's 07/07/2024 boarding by ten months.
cost_if_not_cured: A defendant demonstrating from the plaintiff's own cited ledger that it did not exist on the account at the time alleged.
notes: This is the single most checkable factual error in the pleading and the cheapest to fix.

what_the_test_showed: P 29 pleads that EACH of the four TPP payments was reversed. The ledger Plaintiffs themselves rely on shows the 05/17/2025 tender was NEVER reversed and remains the Ending Unapplied Balance of $1,899.56.
cure: Plead three reversals and one retained-but-unapplied tender. The correction STRENGTHENS the count.
cost_if_not_cured: An exhibit contradicting an allegation is generally credited over the allegation - and here it would cost Plaintiffs their best documented fact.
notes: THE MOST VALUABLE FINDING OF THIS SCAN. The pleading understates its own strongest evidence.

where: Count XIV (Loss of Consortium) and the FCRA counts as to Kelsey Carrelha
what_the_test_showed: The extract does not show facts establishing Kelsey Carrelha's separate injury for each count in which she joins. P 10 pleads she is a borrower and joint tenant, which supports some counts but was not traced count by count.
cure: Plead each Plaintiff's injury per count, or limit counts to the Plaintiff who suffered the pleaded injury.

where: Count XI (Georgia Fair Business Practices Act)
what_the_test_showed: The GFBPA ante litem notice requirement is not shown as pleaded anywhere in the extract reviewed.
cure: Plead the date, method and content of the pre-suit notice, and attach it - if it was given.
cost_if_not_cured: Dismissal of the GFBPA count, and a damages theory (treble damages) lost with it.
notes: CONFIDENCE LOW - Count XI's body was not read. Flagged because this requirement is routinely fatal and routinely missed.

what_the_test_showed: Suit was filed 03/02/2026. 15 U.S.C. 1692k(d) carries a one-year period. Conduct pleaded from 2023 and 2024 is facially outside it, and no continuing-violation or discovery theory is pleaded.
cure: Narrow the FDCPA count to conduct on or after 03/02/2025 - which still includes the entire 2025 TPP sequence and the whole 12/2025-01/2026 four-letter sequence - or plead a tolling theory with its basis.
cost_if_not_cured: A facial limitations bar handed to Defendants on the pleading's own dates, on a count that is otherwise one of the strongest.
notes: Limitations is an affirmative defense and supports dismissal only when the bar appears on the face of the pleading. This pleading puts it there unnecessarily. ISS-007.

what_the_test_showed: P 3 refers to 'failure of consideration in the underlying obligation (Count X) and Security Deed unenforceability derivative of the underlying obligation (Count XI)'. The Count headings place Failure of Consideration at COUNT IX and Security Deed Unenforceability at COUNT X. The cross-reference is off by one.
cure: Renumber the cross-reference in P 3 to match the headings.
cost_if_not_cured: Trivial alone. In a pleading filed under an order to replead carefully, a self-inconsistent cross-reference invites a harsh reading of everything else - and this is the same FAMILY of error Doc. 35 already sanctioned once.
notes: Found by mechanically diffing count numbers in headings against count numbers in cross-references. Free to fix.
